$comment: Reviewed npm advisories in the PRODUCTION dependency tree that CI tolerates until `expires`. Each needs a reason it is not exploitable in BureauOS. scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails CI on any high/critical advisory not listed here, and on any entry past its expiry. Remove entries as soon as the upgrade lands.

advisories.reason: Stack exhaustion when merging a recursive object graph. Only the Prisma CLI's own configuration loader merges objects with it, at generate/migrate time, on config BureauOS controls. No user input reaches it and it is not in the request path. Fixed upstream only in Prisma 7 (major upgrade).

Arbitrary file read via an attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL in CSS. PostCSS only processes BureauOS's own stylesheets at build time; the app never accepts or processes CSS from users. Fixed upstream only in Next 16 (major upgrade).
Path traversal in source-map auto-loading — same precondition as GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q: attacker-controlled CSS, which BureauOS never processes.
Incomplete fix of GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q; same precondition (attacker-controlled CSS). Moderate.
XSS through unescaped </style> in PostCSS's stringify output — only relevant when stringifying untrusted CSS into a page. BureauOS stringifies only its own build-time CSS. Moderate.
